groups.reason: Eight closely timed events form one dependent sequence and must remain in one split if later used.
Only one independent event group is available, so it cannot establish validation or holdout performance.

assignmentRules: Do not split any group across calibration, validation, or holdout.
Do not tune the PGV inversion, IQR gate, or station filters on a group before its assignment is frozen.
Require independently sourced final earthquake parameters before using a group for calibration error metrics.
Do not expose the diagnostic value as SourceEstimate.magnitude or UI data until calibration, validation, and holdout groups all pass their predeclared checks.
